notes.title: Hard Reset Redux system requirements and release date revealed
Hard Reset Gets a Little Softer With Patch 1.01
notes.notes: Was Flying Wild Hog's cyberpunk shooter Hard Reset too hard for you? Patch 1.01 eases your pain, removing weapon cooldowns, improving gun swapping speed, tweaking the sprint system, and allowing players the mercy of mid-game difficulty changing. Pansies. [Steam Forums]
